title: Per-package changelog sections
brief: Concrete rendering of ADR-0002 option (c) for workspace releases: one shared version, one tag, and path-filtered changelog sections per package. Baseline for the WU1-WU3 implementation slices.

artboards.title: Package sections, as rendered
artboards.tradeoff: The target output read as a document: package heading above categories, declaration order, unowned commits under Other changes. Best for judging the shape a reader will actually see.

artboards.title: Edge cases the rule must survive
artboards.tradeoff: Same output with a rules rail: root package, nested paths, a commit in two packages, unowned commits, empty packages. Denser than a pure specimen, but it is where the design gets falsified.

artboards.title: Before, after, and the switch
artboards.tradeoff: Side-by-side contrast plus the cutver.toml key that enables it. Strongest for a reviewer deciding whether the change is worth its schema cost; hides the edge-case rules.
